name: Raptoran
author: Skip Williams
sourceDistinctions: Gliding is available before powered flight. The 5 and 10 HD thresholds are advancement on one playable profile.
The published Sentry is a separate Ranger 5. The p. 184 Youth Pilgrim lists fly speed despite having 1 HD. Both original builds follow the playable thresholds.
The 10 HD playable endurance wording differs from the 10-minute daily limit retained by several 10+ HD published NPCs.
The playable list supplies no level adjustment; the new builds use ECL equal to class level.
